keyMappings:
map a Vomnibar.activateTabSelection
map A Vomnibar.activateInNewTab
map c toggleMuteTab
map d scrollPageDown
map D goForward
map e nextTab
map E goPrevious
map F LinkHints.activateModeToOpenInNewForegroundTab
map h showHelp
map R goNext
map s scrollPageUp
map S goBack
map r reload
map q focusInput
map Q LinkHints.activateModeToOpenIncognito
map w previousTab
map x removeTab
map X restoreTab
map z visitPreviousTab
map 0 firstTab
map $ lastTab

unmap m
map mf LinkHints.activateModeWithQueue
map v LinkHints.activateModeWithQueue
map < moveTabLeft
map > moveTabRight
# map arrow goNext
searchEngines:
a: http://google.com/?q=%s
